title: Publish atomic reusable delete and task detachment
description: Implement provider deletion by name or UUID using the reusable-update transaction. Resolve one definition, compute every referencing task across all configured statuses and branch scopes, remove that UUID from each ordered assignment list, advance affected task updatedAt monotonically, and delete the definition from the after catalog. Publish prepared and committed states so success is all-or-nothing across catalog and tasks, then return the deleted definition and exact detachedTaskCount. Deleting an unreferenced definition must use the same safe path. Add concurrency and fault-point tests covering multiple assignments per task, completed and in-progress tasks, shared stores, simultaneous readers/writers, every publication boundary, rollback, roll-forward recovery, and retry after interruption. Do not append audit comments or alter unrelated task fields.
